chunks: "It is the right hand of Allah on His earth, with which He shakes hands with His creation."

key_terms.يَمِينُ: right hand; an expression of honor and special attribution

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean that it is the right hand of Allah on earth?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a sacred object or rite of hajj with an exalted expression of honor and nearness to Allah. It conveys the spiritual dignity of that act in devotional life and its special status among the symbols of worship.
